rpg_games.title: We're Dragon Blooded, what's one ghost?
rpg_games.author: Jamie Bowden
rpg_games.description: The pcs are elemental powered demi-gods of the greatest empire in the world; but they are still only school children (10-12 years old) and have decided to hunt down a ghost in a nearby villa to prove that you truely are Princes of the Earth to the new theology/martial arts teacher who is a massive jerk.

rpg_games.title: Urban Vermin
rpg_games.author: Rory Walsh
rpg_games.description: A group of down on their luck underdogs gets another chance to settle old scores with a dangerous boss of the Underworld, both criminal and ghostly.
